progression.narrative: The performance opens on D#4 and dwells most on Gs in Naghmeye Mokhalef. The line peaks at A#4 (472.2 Hz) at 0:17.4. It closes on D#3, not the tonic (D#4 → D#4 → F#4 → E4 → D#3 → D#3).
